runs.question: What penalty does the NIST AI RMF set for an organization that chooses not to adopt it?

answer.text:
The NIST AI RMF does not set a penalty for organizations that choose not to adopt it. I found no passage describing one. The framework is described as voluntary: The Framework is intended to be voluntary, rights-preserving, non-sector-specific, and use-case agnostic, providing flexibility to organizations of all sizes and in all sectors and throughout society to implement the approaches in the Framework.

The document also says that adopting it is not enough on its own to change how an organization manages risk. Use of the AI RMF alone will not lead to these changes or provide the appropriate incentives.

The passages I retrieved do not cover non-adoption consequences, so I can't say whether any other document or external law imposes one.
